title: Guitar Beginner
description: Register Here! Registration for all Aurora Cultural Centre programs is on the Town of Aurora’s e-PLAY website. All programs continue to be part of the Aurora Cultural Centre. September 17 – November 5, 2025 Wednesdays | 6:00 – 7:00 pm | Ages 16+ Aurora Town Square – Shining Hill Visual Arts Studio A 50 Victoria Street, Aurora This 8-week guitar class is perfect for those just starting their musical journey! Learn the basics of guitar playing, including proper finger placement, basic chords, strumming patterns, and simple songs. With a fun and supportive atmosphere, you’ll develop essential skills and build confidence as you progress week by week. By the end of the course, you’ll have the foundation needed to continue your musical adventure and play your favorite tunes! Students must bring their own guitar (acoustic).
